note: Monthly reviews of the paper stock portfolio and paper/real options. Research, not advice. All figures from repo data (portfolio.json 10/30 close, paper-options-log.csv, degen-log.csv, live-account/ledger.csv).

reviews.title: October 2026
reviews.headline: Stocks finished $17,119.24 against $17,400 put in (-1.61%), but ahead of the same deposits in SPY ($17,009.15) by $110.09. Rulebook options made +$3,801 on paper; the one-off degen trade lost $2,968.

items: Plan is 60% Safe Core, 20% Diversifier, 20% Aggressive. Of the money invested at the 10/30 close it was 47.2% Safe Core, 16.7% Diversifier and 36.2% Aggressive, with $1,400 cash (8.2% of the total).
Aggressive is about 16 points overweight and Safe Core about 13 points underweight. The cause is the dip buys: 8 of 12 tranches ($4,000 of $6,000) went into Aggressive names.
Biggest single names: SMH 7.64% and NVDA 6.12% of the total, both under the 10% cap.
12 dip buys of $500. At the 10/30 close they were worth $109.69 less than paid in total; 3 were up (VRT +18.63%, ITA +2.01%, VXUS on 10/30 +0.47%) and 9 were down.
Pullback buys (R1, 7 buys) were +$32.16 combined. Support-test buys (R2, 5 buys) were all down, -$141.85 combined: the support levels kept breaking after we bought.
Overbuying: GEV and NVDA each got two tranches within days (GEV 10/16 and 10/20, NVDA 10/20 and 10/21) and all four are down 6-8%.

Missed: VOO never got a dip buy, so Safe Core fell further behind. Several names met the pullback rule but waited behind higher-priority picks because cash ran out (TSM, AVGO, GEV are queued for Fri 11/6).

Rulebook paper trades: 14 trades, 7 winners, +$3,801 realized ($5,000 budget is now $8,801 cash). 3 more planned picks were cancelled before filling (NVDA 10/27 missed its trigger; TSLA 10/26 and AMD 10/28 were too big for the size check).
Best: planned bell trades, +$2,128 over 6 (AMD put +$1,217, META call +$702, NVDA call +$660). The COIN earnings straddle netted +$902 (one sample).
Worst: failed-retest gap-down puts, 4 trades, 1 winner (SPCX +$846), 3 losers, -$9 net.

The separate one-time degen 0DTE QQQ call (10/16) lost $2,968 and was bought after the broker's cutoff, so it wasn't a realistic fill. Real Robinhood account: one $1 test round trip plus $0.09 fees; value $500.91 on 10/30.

Recurring mistakes: early trades broke rules (an improvised stop, a bell fill without its trigger, picks made after the open, an early-close call by feel). Most later entries were record-keeping slips caught before reporting.
Send some Friday cash to Safe Core (VOO, BND, SCHD) even without a dip, until Aggressive drifts back toward 20%. This would change the buy rules, so it needs your OK.
Stop using support-test (R2) buys on their own; wait for the pullback rule plus a day that closes back above support.
Cap any one name at two dip tranches a month so we don't keep adding to a falling stock.
Keep trading planned bell setups, but pause failed-retest puts until a review of those 4 trades, and keep the earnings straddle small until it has more samples.
